config.permissions: Offline asset-author settings only; not a live gameplay or server control.
config.effective_time: Applied when rebuilding a new prototype; saved animation does not change until rebaked.

limitations: Rigid motion harness does not animate horse legs.
Selected actual mane/tail regions move; fused geometry and feathered boundaries require cleanup. Remaining hair stays static.
Point/capsule and ground collision, no self-collision or triangle-mesh environment collision.
Collision radius approximates clump thickness; segment interiors and rendered strands need visual review.
Rider is a simplified seated proxy; no saddle/reins rig.
Baked offline animation, not Unreal runtime simulation.

skin.method: Original mesh retained intact; spatially feathered weights; all remaining vertices use StaticBody
